name: mindnote
description: 思维便签 — 让想法有脉络，让计划有着落
author: whh

scripts.make: pnpm build && electron-forge package && node scripts/build-installer.mjs
scripts.test:desktop: pnpm build && node scripts/verify-v20-ui.mjs && node scripts/verify-v20-behavior.mjs && node scripts/verify-desktop.mjs && node scripts/verify-window-shape.mjs && node scripts/verify-native-v12.mjs && node scripts/verify-pinning-v2.mjs
scripts.test:packaged: node scripts/verify-v20-ui.mjs --packaged && node scripts/verify-v20-behavior.mjs --packaged && node scripts/verify-desktop.mjs --packaged && node scripts/verify-window-shape.mjs --packaged && node scripts/verify-native-v12.mjs --packaged && node scripts/verify-pinning-v2.mjs --packaged
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts *.config.* tsconfig.json package.json docs README.md
